parameter.name: scripts

parameter.name: validation

'Y' : 'N', createdByUserId: existing?.createdByUserId ?: userIdValue, createdDate: existing?.createdDate ?: nowTs, lastUpdatedByUserId: userIdValue, lastUpdatedDate: nowTs]

service.description: Runs a script and returns what it gave back; writes nothing. Either a saved script (tenantScriptId) or an unsaved draft (scriptBody + scriptProfile; these also override a saved script's, so the editor can try an edit before saving). The input is read first, then the script runs with no transaction open. A script error is a result (run.ok false, run.error), not a service error. Needs edit access to the tenant.

parameter.name: inputSource
parameter.description: SAMPLE or RUN_RESULT; defaults to the saved script's, else SAMPLE.

parameter.name: inputJson
parameter.description: SAMPLE input; defaults to the saved sample.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: RUN_RESULT: the run result file, as list#GeneratedOutputs names it.

parameter.name: run
parameter.description: {ok, profile, result, units, elapsedMs, logs, error: {kind, message, line, column}}

parameter.name: inputSummary
parameter.description: {source, characters} or {source, fileName, records, totalDifferences, truncated}

set.from: darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access, so it cannot run scripts.')

(!ec.message.hasError() && scriptIdValue) ? darpan.facade.common.TenantScopedFinder.findOneOwnedByTenant(ec, 'darpan.script.TenantScript', 'tenantScriptId', scriptIdValue, tenantId, 'DAR-BE-164 script run target verified against the active tenant after a primary-key read') : null

if.message: Write a script, or choose a saved one.
